mysticShot.name: Archetypal Slime's Aid - Energy Bomb
mysticShot.desc: With Archetypal Slime's aid, you can fire an energy bomb at the Magma Slimes.
mysticShot.h: Activate with the #cInteract/Harvest key#. Firing the energy bomb consumes Slime Power.

crystal.name: Archetypal Slime's Aid - Crystal
crystal.desc: With Archetypal Slime's aid, you can set up a crystal that alters the direction of the Guardian Wave.
crystal.h: Activate with the #cInteract/Harvest key#. Setting up a Crystal Drop deducts from the counter.

onOff.name: Hack - Conversion
onOff.desc: Hack the building's defenses to activate an alternate set of walkways.
onOff.h: #cCost: 20 Energy. Toggles which color of platforms are active#

hacking.name: System Hacking
hacking.desc: Hack into a company drone when standing near the main terminal.

domination.name: Hack - System Lockdown
domination.desc: Disable the building's defenses to sneak the drone into the next security zone.
domination.h: #cCost: 1,000 Energy. Immediately moves the drone into the next security zone#

enterCannon.name: Hack - Defense System
enterCannon.desc: Hack the building's defenses to operate the turret.

dischargeCannon.name: Fire Rail Cannon
dischargeCannon.desc: Unleash a condensed antimatter blast from the turret.
dischargeCannon.h: #cCost: 100 Energy. The rail cannon fires at the selected angle#

bossDown.name: Hack - Control Sentinel
bossDown.desc: Hack the building's defenses to move the Sentinel directly to the electrified area.
bossDown.h: #cCost: 100 Energy. The Angler Sentinel immediately attacks#

wireReset.name: Hack - Reset Wires
wireReset.desc: Hack the building's defense system to reset all wires.

safeZone.name: Hack - Energy Barrier
safeZone.desc: Channel the full energy reserve into a shield capable of withstanding Triton's charge.
safeZone.h: #cCost: 1,000 Energy. Creates an area that is safe from Triton's charge#

onOff_2.name: Hack - Conversion
onOff_2.desc: Hack the building's defenses to activate an alternate set of walkways. Using the suit's function will not consume Energy.
onOff_2.h: #cToggles which color of platforms are active#

tagCooltime.name: Swap Champions
tagCooltime.desc: To swap Champions, press the #cTab key#, then the #cnumber key# corresponding to the Champion you want to swap to.\r\nA Champion's control time doesn't deplete while on standby, and their bond gauge will recover at set intervals. A short cooldown is applied in the preparation stage.
tagCooltime.h: Press the Tab key to enter #cSwap Mode#.\r\nWhen a number key is pressed in #cTag Mode#, you will switch to the corresponding Champion.\r\nCooldown: #cooltime sec

tigerSlash.name: Tiger Slash
tigerSlash.desc:
Focus your energy to expose your target's weak points.
Enter the designated keys to attack the weak points. Certain objects will be destroyed instantly, and boss monsters will take fixed damage based on their level.
#cNormal monsters cannot be targeted by this skill.#
#cPress ESC to cancel.#

Flying.name: Nimbus Cloud
Flying.desc:
Summon and mount a Nimbus Cloud. While mounted on the Nimbus Cloud, you can use Tiger Slash to destroy rocks placed by Shensung.
#cWhile mounted on the Nimbus Cloud, Tiger Slash can be used without consuming Divine Energy, but additional Divine Energy cannot be obtained.#
#cYou can't mount the Nimbus Cloud while flying.#
#cWhile riding the Nimbus Cloud, any active skill or buff effects, mounts, and some summons and placed skills are automatically canceled.#

pull.name: Pull Key
pull.desc: Pull a key to you. Cannot be used if the key is too far away.
pull.h: #cConsumes Divine Energy based on key distance (max 200)\r\n#cCooldown: 0.5 sec

hunterShooting.name: Hunter's Shot
hunterShooting.desc:
Fire a shotgun. On hit, reduces Yetis' #cHP by 4#.
#c - If the shot misses the Yeti, Dusk increases by 20
- Successfully getting a Yeti reduces Dusk by 60
- No cooldown#

hunterCCTV.name: Surveillance Camera
hunterCCTV.desc:
Place a surveillance camera. If a #cYeti with its legs showing# is detected within the camera's radius, it notifies the hunter of its location.

#c - Can place up to 5 cameras
- Cameras cannot be retrieved
Cooldown: 1 sec#

yetiToggleLegs.name: Hide Legs
yetiToggleLegs.desc:
Hide your legs. Reuse to toggle leg state. While legs are hidden, #cJump and Speed are reduced#.

#c- Can only be used when Hunger is 1 or higher
- Legs reappear when Hunger reaches 0
- Cooldown: 1 sec#

yetiDash.name: Dash
yetiDash.desc:
Dash forward. Can be used while jumping.#c

- Consumes 10 Hunger
- Cooldown: 5 sec#

yetiEat.name: Eat Food
yetiEat.desc:
Eat nearby food.

#c- Hunger +100
- Reveals your location to hunters
- Cooldown: 5 sec#

monsterYetiClaw.name: Claws Out
monsterYetiClaw.desc: Scratch your enemies with your beefy Yeti arms. Reduces hunters' #cHP by 4#.#c\n\n - Cooldown: 1 sec#

monsterYetiHaste.name: Hot Pursuit
monsterYetiHaste.desc: Temporarily #cincreases Speed and Jump#.#c\n\n- Cooldown: 5 sec#

monsterYetiRoar.name: Roar
monsterYetiRoar.desc: Roar with your mighty Yeti lungs.#c\n\n- Cooldown: 3 sec#
